product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Fulton Modern Rustic Dining Table, 71"L, Natural
product.description: Inspired by Scandinavian designs, this dining table features slats of acacia set in angled patterns for a rustic feel, which is accented by slightly tapered metal legs and sleek metal handles. The transitional design combines easily with contemporary and minimalist styles for a look that suits you. 71"L x 39"D x 30"H Acacia top and metal legs Metal legs and sleek handles provide a rustic feel This Scandinavian-inspired design creates a sleek and minimalist look. Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes Avoid moisture. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
